verdict.rationale: The only evidence of AI agents inside the product is a single marketing line on the Forter homepage, "Meet your new team of Forter Agents" (forter-docs-12), with no documentation of what they do or how users assign them tasks. The documented MCP server (forter-docs-9, forter-docs-20) supports delegating actions through natural language, but only from an external assistant such as Claude Desktop, not one built into Forter. Missing for 10: documented in-product assistant, a description of which tasks can be delegated and how, first-party docs on the Forter Agents, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
